about.title: About Me
about.name: Kagabo Irene Lucky
about.role: CEO & Founder, Nexatech Rwanda | Co-Founder, Echelon
about.bio: I'm an 18-year-old tech entrepreneur and full-stack developer based in Kigali, Rwanda. I founded Nexatech Rwanda — a consumer technology holding company — where I'm building four B2B2C digital platforms: Shoppa (e-commerce discovery), Tugendane (ride-hailing), Hanoserve (service marketplace), and Verline (agri-tech supply chain). I'm also co-founder of Echelon, an Electronic Billing Machine system for business financial compliance. Beyond building companies, I'm deeply invested in AI system architecture, cloud-native engineering, and solving real African market problems at scale. My goal is simple: become one of Africa's leading technology builders — and I'm already on that path.

services.title: What I Do
services.description: From founding and building companies to engineering AI systems and cloud-native platforms — here is where I create real value:

list.title: Product & Startup Building
list.description: I conceptualize, architect, and launch digital products from zero to market. Currently running four live products under Nexatech Rwanda and co-founding Echelon — all built from the ground up.

list.title: Full-Stack Development
list.description: End-to-end engineering using React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vite, FastAPI, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. I build clean, scalable codebases that are production-ready and maintainable.

list.title: AI System Architecture
list.description: Designing intelligent, continuously learning AI systems using RAG pipelines, vector databases (Weaviate), Gemini API, and multi-LLM orchestration. I build systems that evolve — not just respond.

list.title: Cloud-Native Engineering
list.description: Deploying and managing infrastructure on Oracle Cloud, Firebase, and other cloud platforms. Experienced with Docker, CI/CD workflows, GitHub Actions, and GitLab mirroring for production environments.

list.title: API & Fintech Integration
list.description: Successfully integrated MTN MoMo API across multiple B2B2C platforms, handling payment flows, transaction commissions, and mobile money compliance for the East African market.

list.title: Automation & Workflow Engineering
list.description: Building intelligent automation workflows using n8n, Gemini API, and platform APIs (LinkedIn, Google Sheets). I eliminate manual work with smart, self-running pipelines.

ventures.title: My Ventures
ventures.description: I don't just build features — I build companies. Here are the ventures I've founded or co-founded:

list.name: Nexatech Rwanda
list.description: Founded Nexatech Rwanda as a B2B2C tech holding company operating four digital platforms across e-commerce, mobility, services, and agriculture. Building the infrastructure layer for Rwanda's digital economy.

list.name: Echelon
list.description: Co-founded Echelon, an EBM (Electronic Billing Machine) system that handles business financial compliance, billing, and management — making formal business operations accessible to Rwandan enterprises.

products.name: Shoppa
products.description: A local e-commerce discovery platform connecting Rwandan consumers to nearby businesses and products. Think Google Shopping, built for the Kigali market.

products.name: Tugendane
products.description: A ride-hailing platform for Rwanda. Uber-style mobility, designed for the East African road network and priced for local users.

products.name: Hanoserve
products.description: A marketplace for blue-collar and hands-on services — connecting skilled workers (plumbers, electricians, cleaners, etc.) with households and businesses.

products.name: Verline
products.description: An agri-tech supply chain platform streamlining the connection between farmers, distributors, and buyers — tackling food supply inefficiencies in Rwanda.

education.title: Co-Founded Echelon

education.title: Founded Nexatech Rwanda
education.description: Founded Nexatech Rwanda with a vision to build the consumer digital infrastructure for East Africa. Four products under one roof: Shoppa, Tugendane, Hanoserve, and Verline — all in active development.

list.description: An Electronic Billing Machine (EBM) system that handles business financial compliance, billing, and management for Rwandan enterprises.

blog.title: Blog

testimonials.title: What People Say
testimonials.description: From collaborators and mentors who've seen the work up close.

list.name: Tech Collaborator
list.text: Irene doesn't just write code — she architects systems. Watching her go from concept to working product in weeks is something else entirely.

list.name: Co-Founder, Echelon
list.text: She brings both the technical depth and the business clarity most founders never manage to combine. Echelon wouldn't exist without her.

list.name: Industry Mentor
list.text: Rare to see someone this young already operating at a company-building level. The vision is pan-African, and the execution is catching up fast.
